Welcome to Arkand Care

Kind, reliable care that comes to you — the same friendly face, week after week.

We help older people live well at home with warm companionship and a gentle hand around the house. No hard sell, no long contracts — just good people you can trust. When you’re ready, we’d love a friendly, no-obligation chat.

0% Fully insured & DBS-checked team

What we do

Everyday help, offered with warmth

Everything we do right now is companionship and practical help at home — the kind that keeps life comfortable, sociable and calm.

Companionship

Friendly company and conversation, a cup of tea and a chat, and time spent on the things you enjoy.

Help at Home

Light cleaning and tidying, laundry and ironing, and a gentle hand keeping the home comfortable.

Shopping & Errands

Shopping, collecting prescriptions and running everyday errands, so nothing feels like a chore.

Meal Preparation

Preparing meals and snacks, or simply making sure there’s something warm and nourishing to hand.

Accompanied Outings

A friendly companion for walks, trips to the shops, appointments or a favourite place to visit.

Respite for Carers

Stepping in with warm, companionship-based sitting so family carers can take a well-earned break.

Morning

A warm hello to start the day

We arrive with a smile, open the curtains to the morning light, and put the kettle on for a proper cup of tea and a chat.

Late morning

A gentle hand around the home

A little tidying, the laundry on, the shopping put away — the small things that keep home feeling calm and comfortable.

Afternoon

Good company and fresh air

A favourite hobby, a card game, or a gentle walk to the park — time spent together, at your own pace.

Evening

Settled, safe and cared for

A warm meal prepared, everything in its place, and a friendly goodbye — with the reassurance that we’ll be back soon.

A gentle place to start

What kind of help are you looking for?

Choose what feels closest — we’ll show you how we can help. There’s no wrong answer, and never any pressure.
